description: This file defines an interface 'IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor' which specifies methods for monitoring receiver performance metrics such as initialization, read operations, message receipt, and shutdown, within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring receiver performance metrics in Orleans streaming components.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Tracks attempts to initialize the receiver, recording success/failure, call duration, and exceptions if any.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Tracks read attempts, recording success/failure, call duration, and exceptions.

methods.name: TrackMessagesReceived
methods.description: Tracks the number of messages received and their respective enqueue times during successful reads.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Tracks attempts to shut down the receiver, recording success/failure, call duration, and exceptions.
